messages.body:
Hello finance,

A few notes from the yard before the close. The fleece from T3 has been washed, dried and stored for next winter, and the new logger in the tunnel now records the temperature every half hour, so the overnight lows will be on file from here on. The heater test in T4 passed on Tuesday, and two more rolls of fleece are on order for the autumn.

One more correction to FR-07, from me as the one who signed it: when the lavender on bench B7 was cut back on 21 May, 4 of the 40 reshot from the base and went back on sale. Bench B7 is 36 plants killed, not 40. Bench B8 stays at 22 as I posted in the stock channel, and B9 stands at 12.

Tomas Haig, head grower

messages.body:
Dear Thornfield,

Our summer liner list is attached as usual: perennials in 9cm pots from the second week of June, grasses from July, and the autumn hedging plugs can be reserved now for October delivery. Our yard is closed for stocktaking on Friday 18 June, and the van rounds move to Tuesdays and Thursdays from July.

A correction to one of our invoices: the delivery of 15 May for PI-8813 (lot PL-2713) held 36 plants, not 40. One tray of four Hosta was left on our loading bay when the van was packed, and it will not be sent. Please treat PI-8813 as corrected to 36 plants at 3.05 a plant; a corrected copy follows by post.

Kestrel Liners, Accounts
